name: Kaito
concept: A single centered disciplined cyberpunk courier, one person only, protecting a quiet district in a rain-soaked megacity.
body_type: athletic adult with natural balanced proportions
face: fully visible masculine anime face, angular but natural jaw, straight nose, exposed skin, calm alert expression
hair: short straight black hair, clearly visible around the forehead and temples, with exactly one narrow cobalt-blue front streak
outfit: simple matte charcoal courier jacket with restrained cobalt-blue edge piping, fitted black cargo trousers with minimal pockets, and plain black combat boots
props: one compact messenger bag resting on character-right hip, with its strap crossing from character-left shoulder
additional_notes: One subject only, one body, one head, centered in frame. This is a front-facing design candidate, not a turnaround and not an action pose. The face must be uncovered and clearly readable. Show short black hair and exactly one narrow cobalt-blue streak on character-left, viewer-right in the front view. Keep the messenger bag on character-right hip, viewer-left in the front view, and never mirror asymmetric details. Use a restrained animation-ready design: 70 percent clean natural anime production finish and 30 percent simplified modern cyberpunk energy. No helmet, mask, visor, armor headgear, faceless mannequin, or rear-facing subject.
